hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ ، يَقُولُ : " عِدَّةُ الْمُطَلَّقَةِ الْأَقْرَاءُ ، وَإِنْ تَبَاعَدَتْ " *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by a man from the Ansar: That his wife asked him for divorce, so he said to her: 'When you menstruate, inform me.' When she menstruated, she informed him. He said: 'When you become pure, inform me.' When she became pure, she informed him, so he divorced her. Malik said: This is the best of what I have heard about that.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ ، أَنَّ امْرَأَتَهُ سَأَلَتْهُ الطَّلَاقَ ، فَقَالَ لَهَا : " إِذَا حِضْتِ فَآذِنِينِي " ، فَلَمَّا حَاضَتْ آذَنَتْهُ ، فَقَالَ : " إِذَا طَهُرْتِ فَآذِنِينِي " ، فَلَمَّا طَهُرَتْ آذَنَتْهُ ، فَطَلَّقَهَا . قَالَ مَالِك : وَهَذَا أَحْسَنُ مَا سَمِعْتُ فِي ذَلِكَ *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad and Sulayman ibn Yasar: That Yahya ibn Sa'id ibn al-'As divorced the daughter of Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hakam with a final divorce, so Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hakam moved her (from her house). Aisha, the Mother of the Believers, sent to Marwan ibn al-Hakam, who was at that time the governor of Madinah, and said: 'Fear Allah and return the woman to her house.' Marwan said in the hadith of Sulayman: 'Indeed Abd al-Rahman overpowered me.' And Marwan said in the hadith of al-Qasim: 'Has the matter of Fatimah bint Qays not reached you?' So Aisha said: 'It does not harm you not to mention the hadith of Fatimah.' So Marwan said: 'If the evil was with you, then what is between these two is sufficient evil for you.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَسُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُمَا يَذْكُرَانِ أَنَّ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ طَلَّقَ ابْنَةَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ الْبَتَّةَ ، فَانْتَقَلَهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ ، فَأَرْسَلَتْ عَائِشَةُ أُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِلَى مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ ، وَهُوَ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَمِيرُ الْمَدِينَةِ ، فَقَالَتْ : اتَّقِ اللَّهَ ، وَارْدُدِ الْمَرْأَةَ إِلَى بَيْتِهَا ، فَقَالَ مَرْوَانُ فِي حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ : إِنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ غَلَبَنِي ، وَقَالَ مَرْوَانُ فِي حَدِيثِ الْقَاسِمِ : أَوَ مَا بَلَغَكِ شَأْنُ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ ؟ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ : لَا يَضُرُّكَ أَنْ لَا تَذْكُرَ حَدِيثَ فَاطِمَةَ ، فَقَالَ مَرْوَانُ : " إِنْ كَانَ بِكِ الشَّرُّ فَحَسْبُكِ مَا بَيْنَ هَذَيْنِ مِنَ الشَّرِّ " *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Nafi': That the daughter of Sa'id ibn Zayd ibn Amr ibn Nufayl was married to Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Uthman ibn Affan, and he divorced her with a final divorce, so she moved (from her house), and Abdullah ibn Umar disapproved of that upon her. And narrated from Nafi': That Abdullah ibn Umar divorced a wife of his in the residence of Hafsah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ, and it was his route to the mosque, so he used to take the other route from behind the houses, disliking to seek permission to enter upon her, until he took her back.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، " أَنَّ بِنْتَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ ، كَانَتْ تَحْتَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ ، فَطَلَّقَهَا الْبَتَّةَ ، فَانْتَقَلَتْ ، فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ " * وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ " طَلَّقَ امْرَأَةً لَهُ فِي مَسْكَنِ حَفْصَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، وَكَانَ طَرِيقَهُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ ، فَكَانَ يَسْلُكُ الطَّرِيقَ الْأُخْرَى مِنْ أَدْبَارِ الْبُيُوتِ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَسْتَأْذِنَ عَلَيْهَا ، حَتَّى رَاجَعَهَا " *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Yahya ibn Sa'id: That Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab was asked about a woman whose husband divorces her while she is in a rented house, upon whom is the rent? So Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab said: 'Upon her husband.' He said: 'And if her husband does not have (money)?' He said: 'Then upon her.' He said: 'And if she does not have?' He said: 'Then upon the Amir (ruler).'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ يُطَلِّقُهَا زَوْجُهَا وَهِيَ فِي بَيْتٍ بِكِرَاءٍ ، عَلَى مَنِ الْكِرَاءُ ؟ فَقَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ : " عَلَى زَوْجِهَا " ، قَالَ : فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَ زَوْجِهَا ؟ قَالَ : " فَعَلَيْهَا " ، قَالَ : فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهَا ؟ قَالَ : " فَعَلَى الْأَمِيرِ " *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Fatimah bint Qays: That Abu Amr ibn Hafs divorced her with a final divorce while he was absent in al-Sham, so his agent sent to her some barley, and she was displeased with it. He said: 'By Allah, you have nothing due from us.' So she came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and mentioned that to him. He said: 'You have no maintenance due from him.' And he ordered her to observe her waiting period in the house of Umm Sharik. Then he said: 'That is a woman whom my companions visit. Observe your waiting period at Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum's (house), for he is a blind man - you can remove your garments at his place. When your waiting period ends, inform me.' She said: 'When my waiting period ended, I mentioned to him that Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan and Abu Jahm ibn Hisham had proposed to me.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'As for Abu Jahm, he does not put down his stick from his shoulder, and as for Mu'awiyah, he is a poor man with no wealth. Marry Usamah ibn Zayd.' She said: 'So I disliked him.' Then he said: 'Marry Usamah ibn Zayd.' So I married him, and Allah placed good in that, and I was pleased with him.

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ مَوْلَى الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ ، أَنَّ أَبَا عَمْرِو بْنَ حَفْصٍ طَلَّقَهَا الْبَتَّةَ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ بِالشَّامِ ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا وَكِيلُهُ بِشَعِيرٍ فَسَخِطَتْهُ ، فَقَالَ : وَاللَّهِ مَا لَكِ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ ، فَجَاءَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ ، فَقَالَ : لَيْسَ لَكِ عَلَيْهِ نَفَقَةٌ ، وَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَعْتَدَّ فِي بَيْتِ أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : تِلْكَ امْرَأَةٌ يَغْشَاهَا أَصْحَابِي ، اعْتَدِّي عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ ، فَإِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ أَعْمَى تَضَعِينَ ثِيَابَكِ عِنْدَهُ ، فَإِذَا حَلَلْتِ فَآذِنِينِي ، قَالَتْ : فَلَمَّا حَلَلْتُ ذَكَرْتُ لَهُ أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ ، وَأَبَا جَهْمِ بْنَ هِشَامٍ ، خَطَبَانِي ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَمَّا أَبُو جَهْمٍ ، فَلَا يَضَعُ عَصَاهُ عَنْ عَاتِقِهِ ، وَأَمَّا مُعَاوِيَةُ فَصُعْلُوكٌ ، لَا مَالَ لَهُ ، انْكِحِي أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ " ، قَالَتْ : فَكَرِهْتُهُ ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " انْكِحِي أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ " ، فَنَكَحْتُهُ ، فَجَعَلَ اللَّهُ فِي ذَلِكَ خَيْرًا ، وَاغْتَبَطْتُ بِهِ *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Ibn Shihab who said: The finally divorced woman (al-mabtutah) does not leave her house until she becomes lawful (her iddah ends), and she has no maintenance unless she is pregnant, in which case maintenance is spent on her until she delivers her pregnancy. Malik said: This is the matter with us.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ ، يَقُولُ : " الْمَبْتُوتَةُ لَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْتِهَا حَتَّى تَحِلَّ ، وَلَيْسَتْ لَهَا نَفَقَةٌ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ حَامِلًا ، فَيُنْفَقُ عَلَيْهَا حَتَّى تَضَعَ حَمْلَهَا " . قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَهَذَا الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا *

hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: The matter with us regarding the divorce of a slave to a slave woman is that if he divorces her while she is a slave, then she is freed afterwards, her waiting period is the waiting period of a slave woman - her freedom does not change her waiting period, whether he had the right to take her back or he did not have the right to take her back - her waiting period does not transfer. Malik said: And similar to that is the punishment that falls upon the slave, then he is freed after the punishment falls upon him, so his punishment is only the punishment of a slave. Malik said: And the free man divorces the slave woman three times, and she observes waiting period with two menstrual cycles. And the slave divorces the free woman with two divorces and she observes waiting period with three menstrual cycles. Malik said regarding the man who has a slave woman as wife, then he purchases her and frees her: She observes waiting period with the waiting period of a slave woman - two menstrual cycles - as long as he has not had intercourse with her. But if he had intercourse with her after owning her before freeing her, she has nothing upon her except purification (istibra) with one menstrual cycle.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ مَالِكٌ : الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا فِي طَلَاقِ الْعَبْدِ الْأَمَةَ إِذَا طَلَّقَهَا وَهِيَ أَمَةٌ ، ثُمَّ عَتَقَتْ بَعْدُ ، فَعِدَّتُهَا عِدَّةُ الْأَمَةِ لَا يُغَيِّرُ عِدَّتَهَا عِتْقُهَا ، كَانَتْ لَهُ عَلَيْهَا رَجْعَةٌ ، أَوْ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ عَلَيْهَا رَجْعَةٌ ، لَا تَنْتَقِلُ عِدَّتُهَا . قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ الْحَدُّ يَقَعُ عَلَى الْعَبْدِ ، ثُمَّ يَعْتِقُ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ ، فَإِنَّمَا حَدُّهُ حَدُّ عَبْدٍ . قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَالْحُرُّ يُطَلِّقُ الْأَمَةَ ثَلَاثًا ، وَتَعْتَدُّ بِحَيْضَتَيْنِ ، وَالْعَبْدُ يُطَلِّقُ الْحُرَّةَ تَطْلِيقَتَيْنِ وَتَعْتَدُّ ثَلَاثَةَ قُرُوءٍ . قَالَ مَالِكٌ فِي الرَّجُلِ تَكُونُ تَحْتَهُ الْأَمَةُ ، ثُمَّ يَبْتَاعُهَا ، فَيَعْتِقُهَا : إِنَّهَا تَعْتَدُّ عِدَّةَ الْأَمَةِ حَيْضَتَيْنِ مَا لَمْ يُصِبْهَا ، فَإِنْ أَصَابَهَا بَعْدَ مِلْكِهِ إِيَّاهَا قَبْلَ عِتَاقِهَا ، لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهَا إِلَّا الْاسْتِبْرَاءُ بِحَيْضَةٍ .

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab who said: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: 'Whichever woman is divorced and menstruates one menstruation or two menstruations, then her menstruation ceases, she waits nine months. If pregnancy appears in her, then that is it. Otherwise, she observes waiting period after the nine months for three months, then she becomes lawful (to remarry).'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ : " الطَّلَاقُ لِلرِّجَالِ ، وَالْعِدَّةُ لِلنِّسَاءِ " *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab that he said: 'The waiting period of the woman with istihadah (irregular bleeding) is one year.' Malik said: The matter with us regarding the divorced woman whose menstruation ceases when her husband divorces her is that she waits nine months. If she does not menstruate during them, she observes waiting period for three months. If she menstruates before completing the three months, she begins anew with menstrual cycles. If nine months pass without her menstruating, she observes waiting period for three months. If she menstruates the second time before completing the three months, she begins anew with menstrual cycles. If nine months pass without her menstruating, she observes waiting period for three months. If she menstruates the third time, she has completed the waiting period of menstrual cycles. If she does not menstruate, she begins anew with three months then becomes lawful. And her husband has the right to take her back during that period before she becomes lawful, unless he had finalized her divorce. Malik said: The Sunnah with us is that when a man divorces his wife and he has the right to take her back, and she observes part of her waiting period, then he takes her back, then separates from her before touching her, that she does not build upon what has passed of her waiting period, and she begins from the day he divorced her with a new waiting period. And her husband has wronged himself and erred if he took her back without need for her. Malik said: And the matter with us is that if a woman accepts Islam while her husband is a disbeliever, then he accepts Islam, he has more right to her as long as she is in her waiting period. If her waiting period ends, he has no way to her. And if he marries her after the end of her waiting period, that is not counted as a divorce, and Islam separated her from him without divorce.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : " عِدَّةُ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ سَنَةٌ " . قَالَ مَالِكٌ : الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ الَّتِي تَرْفَعُهَا حَيْضَتُهَا حِينَ يُطَلِّقُهَا زَوْجُهَا ، أَنَّهَا تَنْتَظِرُ تِسْعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَحِضْ فِيهِنَّ اعْتَدَّتْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ ، فَإِنْ حَاضَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَسْتَكْمِلَ الْأَشْهُرَ الثَّلَاثَةَ اسْتَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَ ، فَإِنْ مَرَّتْ بِهَا تِسْعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ ، اعْتَدَّتْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ ، فَإِنْ حَاضَتِ الثَّانِيَةَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَسْتَكْمِلَ الْأَشْهُرَ الثَّلَاثَةَ ، اسْتَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَ ، فَإِنْ مَرَّتْ بِهَا تِسْعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ اعْتَدَّتْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ ، فَإِنْ حَاضَتِ الثَّالِثَةَ كَانَتْ قَدِ اسْتَكْمَلَتْ عِدَّةَ الْحَيْضِ ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَحِضْ اسْتَقْبَلَتْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ ثُمَّ حَلَّتْ ، وَلِزَوْجِهَا عَلَيْهَا فِي ذَلِكَ الرَّجْعَةُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِلَّ ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدْ بَتَّ طَلَاقَهَا . قَالَ مَالِكٌ : السُّنَّةُ عِنْدَنَا أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَلَهُ عَلَيْهَا رَجْعَةٌ فَاعْتَدَّتْ بَعْضَ عِدَّتِهَا ، ثُمَّ ارْتَجَعَهَا ، ثُمَّ فَارَقَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ ، يَمَسَّهَا أَنَّهَا لَا تَبْنِي عَلَى مَا مَضَى مِنْ عِدَّتِهَا ، وَأَنَّهَا تَسْتَأْنِفُ مِنْ يَوْمَ طَلَّقَهَا عِدَّةً مُسْتَقْبَلَةً ، وَقَدْ ظَلَمَ زَوْجُهَا نَفْسَهُ وَأَخْطَأَ ، إِنْ كَانَ ارْتَجَعَهَا وَلَا حَاجَةَ لَهُ بِهَا . قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَالْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا أَنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ إِذَا أَسْلَمَتْ وَزَوْجُهَا كَافِرٌ ، ثُمَّ أَسْلَمَ ، فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهَا مَا دَامَتْ فِي عِدَّتِهَا ، فَإِنِ انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا فَلَا سَبِيلَ لَهُ عَلَيْهَا ، وَإِنْ تَزَوَّجَهَا بَعْدَ انْقِضَاءِ عِدَّتِهَا لَمْ يُعَدَّ ذَلِكَ طَلَاقًا ، وَإِنَّمَا فَسَخَهَا مِنْهُ الْإِسْلَامُ بِغَيْرِ طَلَاقٍ *
